So stark a contrast as this
Serves to hold back all the notions of knowing
That so flow within this stream of what could be
To reveal what partiality fails in showing.
For what has always been reinforced
As substantial walls towering contain
Is the idea that what I am can provide
Via its modes of knowing some truth ascertained.
But isn’t it so plain when this sight is paired
With the infinite potential of what may accrue
To memory and integrity so coherently proclaiming
A timeless grasping of what finitudes may view.
So in the incessant clamouring for nourishment of Spirit
At no point did the mind of God visit
Lest for those instances so pleadingly still
Wherein mindlessness inspired His quill.
I am now prostrate at the foot of the mountain,
Cold winds biting my bare ankle skin.
Looking up in wonder at arrangements resounding,
As the All of ever was rests unknown within.
